title: Corona Alert: Corona again increased the concern of the government in the country. Corona Third Wave | Pandemic
description: According to the data released by the Union Ministry of Health on Friday morning, 43,393 new cases have been reported in the last 24 hours, while 911 people have lost their lives. At present, 4,58,727 active cases are present in the country, which is 1.49% of the total cases so far.  #Coronaalert #Coronathirdwave #Coronaviruspandemic   Video Courtesy: Doordarshan/Prasar Bharti  Credit: #national | #POORNIMAMISHRA | #TV9  For Latest News Visit | www.tv9hindi.com Subscribe to tv9 bharatvarsh https://goo.gl/udchcy Follow tv9 bharatvarsh on Facebook |  https://www.facebook.com/tv9Bharatvarsh/   Follow TV9 Bharatvarsh on Twitter | https://twitter.com/tv9Bharatvarsh   Watch More TV9 Bharatvarsh Videos | https://www.tv9hindi.com/videos Know All About Political News | https://www.tv9hindi.com/india Know All About Trending News | https://www.tv9hindi.com/trending Know All About Business News | https://www.tv9hindi.com/business Know All About Latest Bollywood News | https://www.tv9hindi.com/entertainment  #TV9Bharatvarsh #Hindinewslive
